annotations.title: Get a sample video ad for a website

description: A short look at the style of your ad: a stored, blurred library montage. Open sample_page_url to see it in your brand colours when the page supplies them; the direct clip is untinted. Your real video is made after you start it. Returns a claim token. The bounded page check takes up to two seconds; the tool waits up to wait_seconds and otherwise returns state 'reading': then call get_sample_status with the claim token every few seconds until it is 'ready'. Nothing is generated or charged by this call.

url.description: The product or company website, e.g. https://example.com

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the sample (default 8).

name: get_video_sample
